description: The native GFS decoder and horizontal mapper physical field contract. The decoder parameter rows are in gfs_grib2_bridge.rs. Their GRIB2 units are published by NCEP in tables 4.2-0-0, 4.2-0-1, 4.2-0-2, 4.2-0-3, 4.2-2-0 and 4.2-10-2. These are declared source semantics, never inferred from an array range.

levels_hpa.operation: verified native decoder pressure_levels_pa divided by 100

field__RH.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; GFS water-relative convention retained

field__GHT.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; native geopotential-height numeric values retained, no division

field__UU.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; earth-relative winds rotated to the target x direction

field__VV.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; earth-relative winds rotated to the target y direction

field__SOURCE_OROGRAPHY.operation: native bilinear interpolation; native geopotential-height numeric values retained, no division

field__RH2.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; GFS water-relative convention retained

field__U10.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; earth-relative winds rotated to the target x direction

field__V10.operation: native overlapping-parabolic horizontal interpolation; earth-relative winds rotated to the target y direction

field__SKINTEMP.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__SNOW.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__SNOWH.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__XICE.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__LANDSEA.operation: target interpolation landmask; target lakes select land atmospheric/soil donors

meta__soil_no_source_land.operation: native masked soil interpolation had no source-land donor

field__GFS_ST000010.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_SM000010.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_ST010040.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_SM010040.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_ST040100.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_SM040100.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_ST100200.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained

field__GFS_SM100200.operation: native WPS masked land/sea interpolation chain; source units retained
